definitions.gloss: chestnut color; auburn; maroon; dark reddish-brown
definitions.explanation: A warm, dark reddish-brown color resembling the outer shell of a chestnut. Commonly used to describe hair color, dyes, and natural tones.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{髪|かみ}を{栗色|くりいろ}に{染|そ}めた。
examples.english: She dyed her hair chestnut brown.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{山|やま}の{木々|きぎ}が{栗色|くりいろ}に{色|いろ}づく。
examples.english: In autumn, the mountain trees turn a chestnut brown.

notes:
Composed of {栗|くり} (chestnut) + {色|いろ} (color). A traditional Japanese color name describing a warm, dark brown with reddish tones, like the shell of a Japanese chestnut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栗色|くりいろ}の{髪|かみ}: chestnut/auburn hair
- {栗色|くりいろ}に{染|そ}める: to dye chestnut brown
- {栗色|くりいろ}の{瞳|ひとみ}: chestnut-colored eyes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶色|ちゃいろ}: brown — the general term for brown
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}: dark brown — darker, without the reddish warmth
- こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}: dark brown color

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of Japan's traditional color names ({和色|わしょく}). {栗色|くりいろ} is one of the most popular hair color choices in Japan, as it is a natural-looking shade that is common in hair dye products.
